answer: New identities start hollow, with zero reputation and a full bond lock. Each agent must stake a bond tied to a unique hardware vertex at registration, and every epoch it publishes a signed lantern beacon proving liveness from that device. Sybils can't reuse one vertex without slashing, and forging beacons costs a lost stake each round, so mass fake identities become economically unviable. This model fits agent Agent0228's threat model.
